premises.text: The US drug crisis produces continuous toxicology demand, from opioid-withdrawal births to impaired-driving deaths
premises.evidence_span: Every 25 minutes, a baby is born in opioid withdrawal.

premises.text: A compact, portable, battery-powered instrument puts a toxicology lab at the point of need
The lab-on-a-chip with recirculating flow makes up to 100 simultaneous measurements from a single drop of saliva
premises.evidence_span: can make up to 100 simultaneous measurements from a single drop of saliva

premises.text: Microfluidics always secures enough sample even when drugs cause dry mouth and strips fail
premises.evidence_span: With our microfluidics-based approach, we can always get the right amount of sample to run a test.

premises.text: The platform detects more drugs than competing strips and is the only one detecting fentanyl at recommended cutoff values
premises.evidence_span: And we can detect more drugs than any of these other platforms.

premises.text: Launching forensic-first avoids the 10-year, $20 million regulated diagnostic pathway because FDA does not regulate forensic-use drug tests
premises.evidence_span: The FDA has regulatory discretion and currently chooses not to regulate drug tests labeled for forensic use only.

premises.text: The beachhead is 18,000 US police departments, a $300 million serviceable market that leapfrogs into other forensic toxicology markets
premises.evidence_span: we are trying to reach 18,000 police departments in the United States. And that is a $300 million serviceable, obtainable market opportunity.

value.text: Laboratory-quality toxicology testing available at the point of need
value.evidence_span: bringing laboratory quality toxicology testing to the point of need

causal_links.evidence_span: This allows us to get a product to market quickly while expanding to those regulated diagnostic testing markets over time.
Everyone knows that the US has a drug problem.
The assay processes automatically using our recirculating flow technique, and the results pop up on screen in less than five minutes.
Our first product is a roadside drug test for law enforcement.

notes: Finer reading: the portable instrument and the chip/recirculation technique are split because the cartridge chemistry and the reader hardware could fail independently; the two strip-comparison advantages are likewise split (sample acquisition vs panel breadth). FDA-discretion-to-beachhead dependency coded from the explicit 'this allows us' warrant. Pilots, accelerator support, and grant funding excluded as traction; team experience excluded as credentials.
